'''Supply Base''' was a refitting base located at [[Gwar]]. It was a [[XQ6 Platform]] controlled by the [[Zaarin coup forces]] as of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

The Supply Base was host to a great deal of weapons and supplies in use by Zaarin's traitor forces, as well as many capital ships under his command. Among the vessels stationed here prior to its destruction was the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] [[Bomb (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Bomb'']] and a trio of [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|Nebulon-B2 modified frigates]] of [[Kuma group|''Kuma'']] group. Along with this powerful formation of warships, the Supply Base also hosted a large starfighter screen and a large minefield.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] pursuit of the traitorous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], Captain [[Kuuztin]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Courageous (Imperial-class)|''Courageous'']] saw fit to catch Zaarin's forces off guard by assaulting his forces at Gwar without notifying [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of his intentions. The assault was led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who pushed through the Supply Base's formidable defenses and were ultimately successful in laying waste to the entire formation of warships and starfighters defending the base despite fierce resistance from the enemy. Zaarin eventually reinforced the base with two of his own Star Destroyers and several squadrons of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] during the battle, and these proceeded to destroy the ''Courageous'', but were ultimately unsuccessful in preventing the destruction of the Supply Base at Stele's hands.
